text: [102] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ussaṅkitaparisaṅkito hoti pāpabhikkhūti api akuppadhammo katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vesiyagocaro 2 vā hoti vidhavāgocaro vā hoti thullakumārīgocaro vā hoti paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu #1 ma. yu. khosaddo natthi . 2 po. ma. vesiyāgocaro . ussaṅkitaparisaṅkito hoti pāpabhikkhūti api akuppadhammoti .
